title: The Interpretation of the Vision Concerning the Fourth Beast and the Ten Kings
description: Daniel is troubled by the vision of the four beasts and asks one who stands there for an explanation. He is told that the four beasts are four kings, but that the holy people of the Most High will eventually receive the kingdom forever. Daniel especially wants to understand the fourth beast with iron teeth and bronze claws, and the little horn that rose up among the ten horns and spoke great words. The angel explains that the ten horns are ten kings, and that another king shall rise who will overthrow three of them, speak against the Most High, and oppress the holy people for a time, times, and half a time. But judgment will be set, his power will be taken away, and the kingdom will be given to the holy people of the Most High as an eternal kingdom. Daniel is frightened by what he has seen, but keeps the matter in his heart.
